title: Integer / Two's Complement
markdown:
#### Integer / Two's Complement

• N-bit：2ᴺ distinct Bit Patterns / Values

  ◦ Range：Unsigned 0～2ᴺ−1；Signed −2⁽ᴺ⁻¹⁾～2⁽ᴺ⁻¹⁾−1

• Two's Complement 补码：N-bit Signed 整数表示；MSB = 1 的 N-bit 值 → Unsigned Value − 2ᴺ

• MSB / LSB：MSB = Most Significant Bit - 最左位

  ◦ Signed Two's Complement 中亦为 Sign Bit（0=非负，1=负）

  ◦ LSB = Least Significant Bit - 最右位，权重 1，不是符号位

• Signed Bit Weights 补码位权：MSB 仍参与计算，位权变为负；其余位权为正 e.g.10110010₂ = −128+32+16+2 = −78
